implementation.method: Standard-library parsing of original command base64, source git objects, raw markers, fixture receipts, and bounded service-subdump lines.

limits: Raw handles omitted from the producer output cannot be independently reconstructed. Counts of unrelated types/packages remain producer observations; retained-row counts, binder-ID counts and predicates were recomputed.
Binder IDs are process-local retained identities. The audit does not equate Java token strings, IMS tokens or Binder IDs across the two processes.
The IME dump and screenshot follow raw collection; neither is an atomic snapshot of a particular callback.
Only the keyboard-related Configuration token is compared; no claim that every resource/display field is unchanged.
A→B order, warm state and fixture reinstall with UID change are explicit confounds. Other secure keys differ between broad snapshots; their writers and exact change times were not observed.
The single B positive arrived 8.135 seconds after show, following a 7.558-second callback gap; this does not satisfy or alter the original Notes five-second budget.
The gap establishes absence of recorded callbacks between two observations, not continuous emptiness or the precise first time the native region became nonempty.
Normal Java unregister return is not an independently observed SurfaceFlinger removal acknowledgment.
